title: padus racemosa f. bracteosa
intro: Padus racemosa f. bracteosa, commonly known as the Chokeberry, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, as well as its ability to support cardiovascular health and immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents present in Padus racemosa f. bracteosa also include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
